paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Niddah 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.55b.17), saying: “What is Rav’s reason?”[^1]

notes.text: Rav Chiyya bar Gurya asks why Rav takes his position. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1292&lang=en) cites this passage under the abbreviated title ר׳.
